subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeretail.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and a few asks so we can put together a tailored pro-forma pricing sheet: 

Key notes from the call:
- Use case: personalized recommendations + search re-ranking inside Acme Retail mobile/web experience.
- Expected traffic: 5M user requests/month (peak distribution: 10% peak hour).
- Typical request size today: ~30 tokens prompt / ~70 tokens completion (avg 100 tokens end-to-end).
- Latency SLOs: P95 <= 300ms for chat endpoints; embeddings used for vector search offline/nearline.
- Security: will require VPC/private deployment for production ROI (we discussed Dedicated).

What we need from you to finalize a pro-forma:
1) Confirm expected monthly token volumes (or per-request averages) if different from above.
2) Confirm the model mix: chat (completion/chat), embeddings, and rerank volumes as % share.
3) Target budget range or target $/1M tokens you are optimizing towards (helps us show committed vs on-demand pricing).

Next steps I'll take once I have the items above:
- Share a pro-forma pricing workbook with per-model unit economics and a committed vs on-demand comparison (attachment: pro-forma_pricing_acme_v1.xlsx).
- Outline recommended model variants and a suggested pilot (1–3 month) to validate quality/cost.

I’ve attached the call notes (acme_discovery_notes.pdf) and will pull Michael (SE) in for any technical follow-ups.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: pro-forma_pricing_acme_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), acme_discovery_notes.pdf (PDF)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap, that looks right. A couple of clarifications from our side to help you model costs: 

- Confirmed traffic: we expect ~5M requests/month initially, ramp to ~15M over 6 months.
- Token assumptions: we measured ~25 tokens prompt / ~75 tokens completion (so ~100 tokens total) — agrees with your note.
- Proposed model mix: chat/completions ~70%, embeddings ~20% (used for upserts and periodic search refreshes), rerank ~10% (higher CPU but lower token counts).
- Budget range: initial run-rate budget is tight — target $4k–6k/month for the pilot; long-term we can expand if unit economics look favorable.

Open questions for you:
1) Can you show a worked example of unit economics (per 1M tokens) using our model mix?
2) What discounts are possible if we commit to a 6–12 month Dedicated reservation?

If you can send the pro-forma I’ll share it with our finance and engineering leads (Priya cc’d).

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform, Acme Retail
alex.johnson@acmeretail.com

> Hi Alex / Priya —
> 
> Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and a few asks so we can put together a tailored pro-forma pricing sheet: 
> ...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeretail.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Alex / Priya —

Thanks — based on the volumes and model mix you shared I put together a worked example below (rounded to simplify):

Assumptions (monthly):
- Total tokens/month: 120M (5M requests * ~100 tokens/request)
- Model mix: chat 70% (84M tokens), embeddings 20% (24M tokens), rerank 10% (12M tokens)

On-demand unit economics (example):
- Chat (generation, low-latency): $40 per 1M tokens -> 84 * $40 = $3,360
- Embeddings (upsert/encode): $20 per 1M tokens -> 24 * $20 = $480
- Rerank (higher compute per token): $60 per 1M tokens -> 12 * $60 = $720
- Estimated monthly cost (on-demand): $3,360 + $480 + $720 = $4,560

Committed / Dedicated pricing (example):
- Typical committed discounts: 25–35% depending on term and reserved GPU profile.
- If we model a 30% reserved discount: Estimated monthly cost -> ~$3,200 (for same usage).

Notes & next steps:
- The per-1M numbers above are illustrative (we’ll calibrate to the exact model variants you choose).
- If your target pilot budget is $4k–6k/month, this example lands inside that window on on-demand pricing and comfortably inside with a modest committed discount.
- Attached is the pro-forma workbook (pro-forma_pricing_acme_v1.xlsx) with line-item math for different model variants, token sensitivity, and a 6/12-month committed scenario.

Requested items from you to finalize the quote:
- Confirm whether you want us to size the pilot for 5M/month (initial) vs the 15M/month ramp.
- Any internal cap on acceptable P95 latency that would push us to higher-tier model variants.

If this looks good I suggest a short follow-up call with our SE (Michael) to pick model flavors (e.g., cost-focused quantized variants vs higher-quality variants) and then we’ll issue a formal quote/contract.

Thanks — I’ll flag a slot for next week and share the pro-forma now.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pro-forma_pricing_acme_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Marissa —

Saw Alex’s response and the worked example you shared. Quick internal notes: 
- The unit prices you used for the worked example are reasonable as an on-demand starting point.
- For the pilot, I recommend we propose a 20–30% committed discount tier (6–12 months) and include an SLA for P95 latency on chat endpoints.
- I’ll prepare a short SE appendix showing recommended model variants (cost-focused quantized vs high-quality variants) and impacts on latency/cost — will drop into the pro-forma doc.

Ping me when you want me on the follow-up call. Once Alex confirms pilot sizing (5M vs 15M) I’ll finalize the technical appendix.

— Michael
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
